DrChen.description: conversing about NurseLi and Dr. Chen discussing an uptick in patients with low-grade fever and dry cough, and agreeing to route those with fever over 38°C or oxygen saturation below 94% directly to Dr. Chen’s respiratory clinic while performing rapid flu and RSV tests for milder cases at triage. @ <persona> NurseLi
chat: Good morning, Dr. Chen! Just wanted to check—have we seen an increase in patients with fever or shortness of breath today? I’m triaging at the desk and want to make sure I’m routing them correctly to your respiratory clinic if needed.

Good morning, NurseLi. Thanks for checking. I haven’t reviewed the full list yet, but based on early arrivals, yes—there’s been a slight uptick in patients presenting with low-grade fever and dry cough, though shortness of breath remains less common. Please continue routing anyone with fever over 38°C or oxygen saturation below 94% directly to my clinic. For milder symptoms, let’s start with rapid flu and RSV tests at triage before escalation.

Understood, Dr. Chen. I’ll make sure to check temperatures and oxygen levels right away and send those meeting the criteria straight to your clinic. I’ll also arrange rapid flu and RSV tests for anyone with milder symptoms before considering escalation. Thanks for the guidance!
